3b67af.conditions: MatGetRowMaxAbs_MPISBAIJ wildcard receives (mpisbaij.c:2796) only see this call's messages; arrival order is irrelevant
3b67af.reasoning: With rowmax Jacobi, MatGetRowMaxAbs_MPISBAIJ runs once, lazily, at the first PCApply inside GMRES's KSPInitialResidual. Each rank r>0 posts r MPI_Recv(ANY_SOURCE, ANY_TAG) and receives exactly one message from each lower rank. It combines them with an elementwise max, which gives the same result in any order, and each message has the full count. Earlier point-to-point traffic (the MatMult in ex2, the SBAIJ scatters) completed before this. Next comes VecReciprocal/VecPointwiseMult (local) and then the VecNorm Allreduce, a collective with its own matching context. So no later point-to-point message can be sent before every rank has finished its receives. The blocking sends only go upward and the top rank only receives, so the dependency graph is acyclic: no deadlock even with synchronous sends.
